lead.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.6-Cyber as it expands Daybreak into two security tiers
lead.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-5.6-Cyber, a frontier cyber model built on GPT-5.6 Sol and reserved for the new Daybreak Red tier serving trusted partners like Accenture, IBM, CrowdStrike and Cloudflare. The expanded Daybreak program now splits into Blue for basic defense work and Red for security testing and vulnerability research, with OpenAI reporting the model surfaced previously unknown flaws including in Chrome's V8 engine.

top_stories.title: Hyperscalers commit nearly $2 trillion to lock down AI hardware and memory
top_stories.summary: Combined purchasing commitments from Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft reached nearly $2 trillion by Q2 2026, with Alphabet and Microsoft accounting for the overwhelming majority, as the big clouds secure accelerator and memory supply well ahead of demand.

top_stories.title: Microsoft plans big production boost for its Maia 300 AI chips
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is ramping next-generation AI chip output, reportedly ordering 300,000+ Maia 300 accelerators from TSMC amid a tightening HBM and AI hardware supply crunch, The Information reported.

top_stories.title: Meta releases Muse Glimmer 30B, an open agentic model for local hardware
top_stories.summary: Meta open-sourced Muse Glimmer, a 30B dense Apache-2.0 model distilled for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware, reaching roughly 230 tokens/s on a single RTX 5090 with day-0 SGLang support and immediate availability on Together AI.

top_stories.title: Aureka Biotechnologies raises $100M Series B for a biological world model
top_stories.summary: Aureka closed a $100M Series B led by Granite Asia and a strategic investor, with HighLight Capital and existing backers MPCi and NRL Capital, to build AI-native biological foundation models for drug discovery.

items.title: Anthropic research Claude pushes Riemann hypothesis lower bound to 67.2%
items.summary: An unreleased research version of Claude raised the proven lower bound on the fraction of Riemann zeta zeros satisfying the hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2% — real progress on a long-standing open problem, without solving it.

items.title: Stealing reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: A new work demonstrates a practical attack that recovers hidden chain-of-thought from encrypted client-side blocks, exposing an information-leakage vector against encrypted CoT schemes.

items.title: Model diffing for feature discovery and control in multimodal LLMs
items.summary: A model-diffing approach decomposes MLLM hidden states into interpretable feature directions, enabling feature discovery, auditing, and post-hoc control of visual-language behavior.

items.title: SKALD distills skills into weights, not prompts
items.summary: An on-policy self-distillation framework distills abstract skills into model weights for cases where verifiable-reward RL yields no group-relative signal — 63-68% of groups in their experiments.

items.title: MixFormer: a linear transformer with mixture of memory experts
items.summary: A linear-transformer variant adds input adaptivity and larger memory capacity via a mixture-of-memory-experts design, targeting information loss in SSM-style long-context modeling.

items.title: Meta brings its AI assistant to the personal computer
items.summary: Bloomberg reports Meta is expanding its AI assistant from mobile and web into the desktop computing experience.

items.title: Microsoft pushes AI agents from coding to finance
items.summary: Bloomberg covers Microsoft's expansion of its AI agent push beyond software development into finance and other verticals, signaling a broader enterprise agent strategy.

items.title: Nous Research ships Hermes Browser Use mode, cutting token usage up to 66%
items.summary: A new Browser Use mode replaces multiple specialized browser tools with a single tool backed by browser_use CLI 3.0, cutting token usage 48-66% with no drop in accuracy.

items.title: Airship: a Figma-like visual editor for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
items.summary: An open-source GUI lets developers build and manage coding-agent projects through a visual canvas instead of the command line.

items.title: Linejudge: an independent verification harness for coding agents
items.summary: An open-source harness that adds a test/check layer to confirm that AI coding agents' output actually works.

items.title: Opencodex: a free open-source coding agent for VSCode
items.summary: A free, open-source AI coding agent that runs inside VSCode for agentic code editing without a paid subscription.

items.title: NuphosAI debuts an AI-native collaborative DevOps workspace
items.summary: An AI-native workspace focused on agent quality, review, and observability aims to improve agent reliability and monitoring in development workflows.

items.title: Discovered Materials closes $9M seed to hunt cooler chip materials with AI agents
items.summary: Lightspeed India led the round with Peak XV and angels including Paul Graham, backing a YC startup that uses swarms of AI agents for semiconductor materials discovery.

items.title: NAVER D2SF backs NdotLight with ~$11M follow-on for physical AI data
items.summary: A KRW 15B round led by Korea Development Bank supports NdotLight's simulation-ready 3D data infrastructure for physical and robotics AI training.

items.title: Lucrative AI exits stealth with $500K pre-seed for MCP-native revenue ops
items.summary: An MCP-native automation play for enterprise revenue operations, using AI agents that interact with data warehouses.
